verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a developer platform (Torch) with a Case Status API, a FOIA API, API keys and a sandbox, so an official CLI is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents any official command-line tool. The APIs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, and the probes show agent-oriented paths returning 403.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
